title: refactor(html): migrate default templates to VDOM
body:
## Summary

This PR migrates the default templates from Hogan.js to VDOM, and adds missing tests for them.

This is necessary before deprecating Hogan.js, to avoid triggering a warning when using default templates.

## Next steps

This PR revealed a number of issues with our current tests and some of our types. I limited the changes and fixes to keep the PR focused and legible, but we should tackle it to avoid slowing down future features.

I filed it as [technical debt](https://algolia.atlassian.net/l/cp/1t8Hz40B) so we can keep track of it.
